IPC_302_BNS_103.title: Punishment for Murder
IPC_302_BNS_103.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_302_BNS_103.punishment_ipc: Death, or Imprisonment for Life, and fine
IPC_302_BNS_103.punishment_bns: Death, or Imprisonment for Life, and fine
IPC_302_BNS_103.statutory_delta: Substantively identical definitions; BNS 103(2) separately introduces mob lynching by 5+ persons with death or life imprisonment.
essential_elements: Intention of causing death (s.300 cl. 1)
Intention of causing bodily injury sufficient in ordinary course of nature to cause death (s.300 cl. 3)
Knowledge that act is imminently dangerous that it must in all probability cause death (s.300 cl. 4)
Absence of all five statutory exceptions to Section 300 (premeditated assault, ambush, poison)

IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.title: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder (With Intention)
IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.charge: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder (Mitigated by Exception)
IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.punishment_bns: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_304_PART1_BNS_105.statutory_delta: BNS Section 105 replaces IPC 304; maintains distinction between intentional act under exception and act with knowledge only.
essential_elements: Act done with intention of causing death or bodily injury likely to cause death
Mitigated by grave and sudden provocation (Exception 1) or exceeding right of private defence (Exception 2)

IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.title: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder (Sudden Fight / Knowledge Only)
IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.charge: Culpable Homicide (Sudden Fight Exception 4 / Knowledge Without Intention)
IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.penalty_tier: Tier 3: 7 to 10 Years (Serious Offence / Substantial Imprisonment)
IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 10 years, or fine, or both
IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 10 years, or fine, or both
IPC_304_PART2_BNS_105.statutory_delta: Applied when fatality occurs in sudden quarrel without premeditation in heat of passion (Exception 4 to s.300).
essential_elements: Act done with knowledge that it is likely to cause death
Done WITHOUT intention to cause death or cause fatal bodily injury
Sudden quarrel, heat of passion, mutual scuffle without offender taking undue advantage

IPC_304A_BNS_106.title: Causing Death by Negligence (Rash Driving / Negligent Act)
IPC_304A_BNS_106.charge: Death by Rash and Negligent Act (Vehicular / Industrial)
IPC_304A_BNS_106.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_304A_BNS_106.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
IPC_304A_BNS_106.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 5 years, and fine (BNS 106(1)); up to 10 years for hit-and-run without reporting (BNS 106(2))
IPC_304A_BNS_106.statutory_delta: CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: BNS 106(1) increased maximum imprisonment from 2 years under IPC to 5 years. Hit-and-run under 106(2) carries up to 10 years.
essential_elements: Death of victim caused directly by act of accused
Act done rashly or negligently without criminal intention or knowledge of inevitable death
Absence of mens rea to cause bodily injury

IPC_304B_BNS_80.title: Dowry Death
IPC_304B_BNS_80.charge: Dowry Death / Cruelty Preceding Unnatural Death
IPC_304B_BNS_80.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_304B_BNS_80.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 7 years, up to Life Imprisonment
IPC_304B_BNS_80.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 7 years, up to Life Imprisonment
IPC_304B_BNS_80.statutory_delta: Re-enacted verbatim as BNS Section 80; presumption of dowry death under Section 113B Evidence Act / Section 118 BSA applies.
essential_elements: Death of woman occurs within 7 years of marriage
Death occurs otherwise than under normal circumstances (burns, poison, asphyxia)
Shown that soon before death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by husband or in-laws in connection with dowry demands

IPC_307_BNS_109.title: Attempt to Murder
IPC_307_BNS_109.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_307_BNS_109.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine; if hurt caused, up to Life Imprisonment
IPC_307_BNS_109.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine; if hurt caused, up to Life Imprisonment
IPC_307_BNS_109.statutory_delta: Substantively identical; requires overt execution step towards murder where victim survives due to intervention or medical care.
essential_elements: Act done with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that if death had been caused, accused would be guilty of murder
Execution of overt act towards commission
Victim survived assault

IPC_308_BNS_110.title: Attempt to Commit Culpable Homicide
IPC_308_BNS_110.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_308_BNS_110.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both; if hurt caused, up to 7 years
IPC_308_BNS_110.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both; if hurt caused, up to 7 years
IPC_308_BNS_110.statutory_delta: Applied when attempted lethal strike occurred under sudden provocation or sudden quarrel where, if death had occurred, it would be s.304.
essential_elements: Act done under circumstances that if death caused, would be culpable homicide not amounting to murder
Absence of premeditated intention to murder

IPC_323_BNS_115.title: Punishment for Voluntarily Causing Hurt (Unarmed)
IPC_323_BNS_115.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_323_BNS_115.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
IPC_323_BNS_115.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both, or community service
IPC_323_BNS_115.statutory_delta: BNS Section 115(2) adds community service as an alternative judicial penalty for petty unarmed hurt.
essential_elements: Voluntary causation of bodily pain, disease, or infirmity to any person
Inflicted without dangerous weapon
Injuries are simple (bruises, slaps, scratches) without fractures

IPC_324_BNS_118_1.title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt by Dangerous Weapons or Means
IPC_324_BNS_118_1.charge: Voluntarily Causing Simple Hurt by Dangerous Weapon
IPC_324_BNS_118_1.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_324_BNS_118_1.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_324_BNS_118_1.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_324_BNS_118_1.statutory_delta: Re-enacted under BNS 118(1); distinguishes simple cuts/incisions with knife from grievous fractures under 118(2).
essential_elements: Voluntarily causing hurt
Inflicted by instrument for shooting, stabbing, cutting, or weapon used offensively
Injury is simple (stitches, superficial knife cuts) without permanent disfigurement

IPC_325_BNS_117_2.title: Punishment for Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt (Unarmed)
IPC_325_BNS_117_2.charge: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt (Bone Fracture / Unarmed)
IPC_325_BNS_117_2.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_325_BNS_117_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_325_BNS_117_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_325_BNS_117_2.statutory_delta: Requires proof of any of the 8 clauses of grievous hurt (e.g., bone fracture, loss of sight/hearing, 20 days severe pain).
essential_elements: Voluntarily causing hurt satisfying definition of grievous hurt (s.320 IPC / s.116 BNS)
Fracture or dislocation of bone or tooth, or permanent privation of member
Caused without dangerous weapons (punches, kicking, blunt stick)

IPC_326_BNS_118_2.title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt by Dangerous Weapons or Means
IPC_326_BNS_118_2.charge: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt by Dangerous Weapons
IPC_326_BNS_118_2.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_326_BNS_118_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_326_BNS_118_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_326_BNS_118_2.statutory_delta: Substantively identical; severe penal consequence for iron rod fractures, sword amputations, or acid attacks.
essential_elements: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt (fracture, severe organ damage)
Inflicted by instrument for stabbing, cutting, firearm, or corrosive substance

IPC_341_BNS_126_2.title: Punishment for Wrongful Restraint
IPC_341_BNS_126_2.charge: Wrongful Restraint (Blocking Passage in Particular Direction)
IPC_341_BNS_126_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_341_BNS_126_2.punishment_ipc: Simple imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to ₹500, or both
IPC_341_BNS_126_2.punishment_bns: Simple imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to ₹5,000, or both, or community service
IPC_341_BNS_126_2.statutory_delta: BNS Section 126(2) increased fine tenfold from ₹500 to ₹5,000 and introduced community service.
essential_elements: Voluntarily obstructing any person
Preventing that person from proceeding in any direction in which that person has a right to proceed

IPC_342_BNS_127_2.title: Punishment for Wrongful Confinement
IPC_342_BNS_127_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_342_BNS_127_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
IPC_342_BNS_127_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹5,000, or both
IPC_342_BNS_127_2.statutory_delta: BNS increased fine ceiling to ₹5,000; total restraint within a room or bounded perimeter.
essential_elements: Wrongfully restraining a person in such a manner as to prevent that person from proceeding beyond certain circumscribing limits
Complete confinement within room, shed, or building

IPC_376_BNS_64.title: Punishment for Rape
IPC_376_BNS_64.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_376_BNS_64.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 7 years, up to Life Imprisonment, and fine
IPC_376_BNS_64.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years, up to Life Imprisonment, and fine
IPC_376_BNS_64.statutory_delta: CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: BNS Section 64(1) raised the MINIMUM statutory sentence from 7 years under IPC to 10 years.
essential_elements: Penetrative sexual act without consent or against will
Absence of genuine free consent under Section 375 IPC / Section 63 BNS

IPC_376D_BNS_70.title: Gang Rape
IPC_376D_BNS_70.charge: Gang Rape (Multiple Perpetrators Acting in Furtherance)
IPC_376D_BNS_70.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_376D_BNS_70.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 20 years, up to Life (remainder of natural life), and fine
IPC_376D_BNS_70.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 20 years, up to Life (remainder of natural life), and fine
IPC_376D_BNS_70.statutory_delta: Re-enacted in BNS Section 70(1); life imprisonment strictly means remainder of natural life.
essential_elements: Rape committed by one or more persons constituting a group or acting in furtherance of a common intention
Each person in the group deemed guilty of gang rape

IPC_354_BNS_74.title: Assault or Criminal Force to Woman with Intent to Outrage Modesty
IPC_354_BNS_74.charge: Assault or Criminal Force to Outrage Modesty of Woman
IPC_354_BNS_74.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_354_BNS_74.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment not less than 1 year, up to 5 years, and fine
IPC_354_BNS_74.punishment_bns: Imprisonment not less than 1 year, up to 5 years, and fine
IPC_354_BNS_74.statutory_delta: Substantively identical; requires physical assault or physical force with intent or knowledge to outrage modesty.
essential_elements: Assault or use of criminal force to any woman
Intention to outrage or knowledge that it will likely outrage her modesty

IPC_354A_BNS_75.title: Sexual Harassment
IPC_354A_BNS_75.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_354A_BNS_75.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both (physical contact); up to 1 year for sexually colored remarks
IPC_354A_BNS_75.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both (physical contact); up to 1 year for sexually colored remarks
IPC_354A_BNS_75.statutory_delta: Covered under BNS Section 75; distinguishes verbal/unwelcome overtures from physical force under s.74.
essential_elements: Physical contact and advances involving unwelcome and explicit sexual overtures, or demand for sexual favors, or sexually colored remarks
Without physical restraint or aggravated assault

IPC_354D_BNS_78.title: Stalking
IPC_354D_BNS_78.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_354D_BNS_78.punishment_ipc: First conviction: up to 3 years and fine; Second/subsequent conviction: up to 5 years and fine
IPC_354D_BNS_78.punishment_bns: First conviction: up to 3 years and fine; Second/subsequent conviction: up to 5 years and fine
IPC_354D_BNS_78.statutory_delta: Re-enacted in BNS Section 78; covers both physical pursuit and monitoring woman's email, social media, or phone use.
essential_elements: Following a woman and contacting or attempting to contact such woman repeatedly despite clear indication of disinterest
Or monitoring use by woman of internet, email, or any other form of electronic communication

IPC_498A_BNS_85.title: Husband or Relative of Husband Subjecting Woman to Cruelty
IPC_498A_BNS_85.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_498A_BNS_85.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine
IPC_498A_BNS_85.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine
IPC_498A_BNS_85.statutory_delta: Re-enacted in BNS Section 85; Arnesh Kumar guidelines mandatory for arrest without Section 41A notice.
essential_elements: Woman subjected to cruelty by husband or relative of husband
Willful conduct driving woman to suicide or grave danger to life, limb, or health
Or harassment with a view to coercing her or relatives to meet unlawful property demands

IPC_379_BNS_303.title: Punishment for Theft
IPC_379_BNS_303.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_379_BNS_303.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_379_BNS_303.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both; first-time theft under ₹5,000 carries community service upon return of property
IPC_379_BNS_303.statutory_delta: BNS Section 303(2) introduces community service for petty theft under ₹5,000 if offender has no prior convictions.
essential_elements: Dishonest intention to take movable property
Property taken out of possession of any person without consent
Movable property moved in order to such taking
Absence of force, threat of force, or house trespass

IPC_380_BNS_305.title: Theft in Dwelling House, etc.
IPC_380_BNS_305.charge: Theft in Residential Building / Vessel / Tent
IPC_380_BNS_305.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_380_BNS_305.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_380_BNS_305.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_380_BNS_305.statutory_delta: BNS Section 305 merges dwelling house and vessel theft; carries aggravated 7-year ceiling compared to simple theft.
essential_elements: Commission of theft as defined in s.378 IPC / s.303 BNS
Committed in any building, tent, or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property

IPC_381_BNS_306.title: Theft by Clerk or Servant of Property in Possession of Master
IPC_381_BNS_306.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_381_BNS_306.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_381_BNS_306.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_381_BNS_306.statutory_delta: Aggravated theft by employee or domestic help in possession of employer's goods.
essential_elements: Theft committed by person employed as clerk or servant
Property belonging to or in possession of employer

IPC_384_BNS_308_2.title: Punishment for Extortion
IPC_384_BNS_308_2.charge: Extortion (Delivery of Property Induced by Fear)
IPC_384_BNS_308_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_384_BNS_308_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_384_BNS_308_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_384_BNS_308_2.statutory_delta: Re-enacted under BNS Section 308(2); victim intentionally put in fear of injury and induced to deliver property.
essential_elements: Intentionally putting any person in fear of any injury to that person or another
Dishonestly inducing person so put in fear to deliver any property or valuable security

IPC_392_BNS_309.title: Punishment for Robbery
IPC_392_BNS_309.charge: Robbery / Extortion with Force or Weapon Threat
IPC_392_BNS_309.penalty_tier: Tier 3: 7 to 10 Years (Serious Offence / Substantial Imprisonment)
IPC_392_BNS_309.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine; if on highway between sunset and sunrise, up to 14 years
IPC_392_BNS_309.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine; if on highway, up to 14 years
IPC_392_BNS_309.statutory_delta: Distinguished from simple theft by presence of immediate physical force, hurt, or imminent threat of death.
essential_elements: Commission of theft or extortion
Causing or attempting to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint
Act done in order to the committing of theft or carrying away property

IPC_395_BNS_310.title: Punishment for Dacoity
IPC_395_BNS_310.charge: Dacoity (Gang Robbery by 5 or More Persons)
IPC_395_BNS_310.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_395_BNS_310.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment for Life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_395_BNS_310.punishment_bns: Imprisonment for Life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_395_BNS_310.statutory_delta: Requires minimum 5 persons acting conjointly to commit or attempt robbery.
essential_elements: Robbery committed or attempted by five or more persons acting conjointly
Each person participating is deemed guilty of dacoity

IPC_397_BNS_311.title: Robbery, or Dacoity, with Attempt to Cause Death or Grievous Hurt
IPC_397_BNS_311.charge: Armed Robbery with Deadly Weapon Brandished
IPC_397_BNS_311.penalty_tier: Tier 3: 7 to 10 Years (Serious Offence / Substantial Imprisonment)
IPC_397_BNS_311.punishment_ipc: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 7 years
IPC_397_BNS_311.punishment_bns: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 7 years
IPC_397_BNS_311.statutory_delta: Sets statutory minimum sentence of 7 years where offender uses deadly weapon during robbery.
essential_elements: Offender uses any deadly weapon, or causes grievous hurt to any person, or attempts to cause death or grievous hurt
Committed during the course of robbery or dacoity

IPC_406_BNS_316.title: Punishment for Criminal Breach of Trust
IPC_406_BNS_316.charge: Criminal Breach of Trust (Misappropriation of Entrusted Property)
IPC_406_BNS_316.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_406_BNS_316.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_406_BNS_316.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both
IPC_406_BNS_316.statutory_delta: CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: BNS Section 316(2) raised punishment ceiling from 3 years under IPC 406 to 5 years.
essential_elements: Entrustment with property or with any dominion over property
Dishonest misappropriation or conversion to offender's own use
Distinguished from cheating: initial entrustment was lawful and voluntary without deception at inception

IPC_409_BNS_316_5.title: Criminal Breach of Trust by Public Servant, Banker, Merchant or Agent
IPC_409_BNS_316_5.charge: Breach of Trust by Public Servant / Banker / Agent
IPC_409_BNS_316_5.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_409_BNS_316_5.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_409_BNS_316_5.punishment_bns: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_409_BNS_316_5.statutory_delta: Aggravated fiduciary breach; public servant, banker, or authorized financial custodian.
essential_elements: Criminal breach of trust committed by public servant, banker, merchant, factor, broker, attorney, or agent
Property entrusted in professional fiduciary capacity

IPC_411_BNS_317_2.title: Dishonestly Receiving Stolen Property
IPC_411_BNS_317_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_411_BNS_317_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_411_BNS_317_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
IPC_411_BNS_317_2.statutory_delta: Re-enacted in BNS Section 317(2); receiver is distinct from original thief but possesses knowing it to be stolen.
essential_elements: Dishonestly receiving or retaining any stolen property
Knowing or having reason to believe the same to be stolen property

IPC_420_BNS_318.title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
IPC_420_BNS_318.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_420_BNS_318.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_420_BNS_318.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_420_BNS_318.statutory_delta: Re-enacted as BNS 318(4); requires fraudulent or dishonest intention operating right from the beginning.
essential_elements: Deception of any person
Fraudulently or dishonestly inducing the person deceived to deliver property or make/alter valuable security
Dishonest intention operating from the very inception of transaction (Hridaya Ranjan Prasad Verma ratio)

IPC_465_BNS_336_2.title: Punishment for Forgery (Simple)
IPC_465_BNS_336_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_465_BNS_336_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
IPC_465_BNS_336_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
IPC_465_BNS_336_2.statutory_delta: Re-enacted under BNS Section 336(2); foundational offence for making false document.
essential_elements: Making false document or false electronic record
Done with intent to cause damage or injury, or support claim or title

IPC_467_BNS_338.title: Forgery of Valuable Security, Will, etc.
IPC_467_BNS_338.charge: Forgery of Valuable Security / Will / Title Deed
IPC_467_BNS_338.penalty_tier: Tier 4: Life Imprisonment / Capital Sentence (Heinous Offence)
IPC_467_BNS_338.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_467_BNS_338.punishment_bns: Imprisonment for Life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
IPC_467_BNS_338.statutory_delta: Aggravated forgery involving deeds, wills, power of attorney, or bank guarantees.
essential_elements: Forgery of document purporting to be a valuable security, will, authority to adopt, or receipt acknowledging money

IPC_468_BNS_336_3.title: Forgery for Purpose of Cheating
IPC_468_BNS_336_3.charge: Forgery for Purpose of Cheating (Fake ID / Appointment Letter)
IPC_468_BNS_336_3.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_468_BNS_336_3.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_468_BNS_336_3.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine
IPC_468_BNS_336_3.statutory_delta: BNS Section 336(3) applies when false certificate, ID, or appointment letter is forged with intent to defraud.
essential_elements: Forgery of document
Intention that document forged shall be used for purpose of cheating

IPC_471_BNS_340_2.title: Using as Genuine a Forged Document
IPC_471_BNS_340_2.charge: Using Forged Document as Genuine (Submitting Counterfeit Record)
IPC_471_BNS_340_2.penalty_tier: Tier 2: 3 to 7 Years (Arnesh Kumar Threshold / Medium Penalty)
IPC_471_BNS_340_2.punishment_ipc: Punished in same manner as if accused had forged the document
IPC_471_BNS_340_2.punishment_bns: Punished in same manner as if accused had forged the document
IPC_471_BNS_340_2.statutory_delta: BNS Section 340(2); targets the user/beneficiary who tenders forged document knowing it to be fake.
essential_elements: Fraudulently or dishonestly using as genuine any document known or believed to be forged

IPC_147_BNS_191_2.title: Punishment for Rioting
IPC_147_BNS_191_2.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_147_BNS_191_2.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
IPC_147_BNS_191_2.punishment_bns: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
IPC_147_BNS_191_2.statutory_delta: Re-enacted under BNS Section 191(2); force or violence used by unlawful assembly of 5+ persons.
essential_elements: Unlawful assembly of five or more persons
Force or violence used by an unlawful assembly or any member thereof in prosecution of common object

IPC_148_BNS_191_3.title: Rioting, Armed with Deadly Weapon
IPC_148_BNS_191_3.penalty_tier: Tier 1: Up to 3 Years (Minor / Summary Offence)
IPC_148_BNS_191_3.punishment_ipc: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

NONE_CIVIL_DISPUTE.penalty_tier: Quashed u/s 482 CrPC / s.528 BNSS (No Penal Term)
NONE_CIVIL_DISPUTE.punishment_ipc: No penal liability - Criminal proceedings quashed as civil dispute
NONE_CIVIL_DISPUTE.punishment_bns: No penal liability - Criminal proceedings quashed as civil dispute
NONE_CIVIL_DISPUTE.statutory_delta: Section 482 CrPC equivalent is Section 528 BNSS; inherently civil disputes cannot be given criminal cloak.

Absence of fraudulent intention at inception (State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal ratio)
